specimen.note: clamp-to-clamp strain rate 0.01 /s; species not stated

processing: box means over 0.1 s (10 raw rows); after the first 10 s of each hold, means over 1 s. No offset removed, no filtering beyond the means.

1.protocol: cyclic: loading cycles to 1..7 mm, then extension to failure

4.protocol: stress relaxation, hold at 10 % clamp strain (1 mm)

5.protocol: stress relaxation, hold at 20 % clamp strain (2 mm)

6.protocol: stress relaxation, hold at 30 % clamp strain (3 mm)

7.protocol: stress relaxation, hold at 40 % clamp strain (4 mm)
